description: Feeds Sysmon Event ID 1 (ProcessCreate) events from Linux syslog XML text or Windows text exports, filing temp-image and encoded-command signals.
name: sysmon_feed

signals.description: A Sysmon Event ID 1 process image is under a temp directory (/tmp, /dev/shm, /var/tmp, a Windows per-user Temp folder, or %TEMP%).
signals.name: sysmon_process_from_temp

signals.description: A Sysmon Event ID 1 command line carries -enc/-encodedcommand (case-insensitive) or a base64-looking token of at least 100 characters.
signals.name: sysmon_encoded_command
